svg.title: Local probability transport for the zebra
svg.desc: The same COCO image strip marks nonuniform candidate-offset positions. Query features, current candidate probabilities, coordinate gaps and sampled stride-8 Mamba features predict signed probability flows between adjacent candidates. The final decoder distribution is corrected within a spatial-distance budget while preserving total probability. The edge is the expectation under the refined distribution. Probability bars and selected offsets are illustrative, not measured model predictions.
svg.text: Budgeted local shifts; total probability stays 1
